functions.name: has_vehicle
functions.doc: Whether the player drives a vehicle right now.
functions.returns: true while the player drives a vehicle

functions.name: vehicle
functions.doc: The player's vehicle's name: manufacturer and type, as its [friendlyname] has them.
functions.returns: the name, or nil without a vehicle

functions.name: vehicle_manufacturer
functions.doc: The manufacturer part of the vehicle's name ("Solaris").

functions.name: vehicle_model
functions.doc: The model part of the vehicle's name ("Urbino 10 / 2D").

functions.name: var
functions.doc: A script variable of the player's bus, by the name its .osc scripts and .opl lists use (Velocity, elec_busbar_main, bus_doorfront0, ...). Without a bus, or for a name the bus does not have, the result is nil.

functions.name: set_var
functions.doc: Sets a script variable of the player's bus.
functions.returns: true when the bus has that variable

functions.name: str
functions.doc: A string variable of the player's bus's scripts (IBIS_terminus_name, ...).

functions.name: set_str
functions.doc: Sets a string variable of the player's bus's scripts.
functions.returns: true when the bus has that variable

functions.name: sys
functions.doc: A system variable of the scripts: Time, Day, Weather_Temperature, ... (read only).

functions.name: trigger
functions.doc: A key press on the bus: fires the trigger, then <name>_off.

functions.name: press
functions.doc: Holds a key of the bus down: fires the trigger and keeps it until release.

functions.name: release
functions.doc: Lets a key held with press go: fires <name>_off.

functions.name: position
functions.doc: Where the bus is: map metres and its heading in degrees.
functions.returns: x, y, z, heading; nothing on foot (several values: a list over the WASM boundary)

functions.name: others
functions.doc: The other vehicles round the bus: AI traffic (kind "ai") and other players' buses in a LAN game (kind "player"). Empty on foot.
functions.returns: a list of {id, kind, name, x, y, z, heading} within radius metres (default 300)

functions.name: other_var
functions.doc: A script variable of one of the vehicles from others().

functions.name: set_other_var
functions.doc: Sets a script variable of one of the vehicles from others(). An AI vehicle keeps it until its scripts write it again; another player's bus takes its values from the network again.
functions.returns: true when that vehicle has the variable

functions.name: info
functions.doc: What the game is doing: map, clock (seconds since midnight), day, year, view, paused, on_foot, multiplayer, traffic, speed (km/h), delay (s, late positive), version; with a bus also its tile and place in it, heading, vehicle_manufacturer, vehicle_model, destination, passengers; crashes, heavy_crashes and pedestrians_hit this session; on a duty line, tour, trip, trips, trip_name, terminus, stops, trip_done, next_stop, next_stop_number, next_stop_arrival, next_stop_departure, next_stop_id, at_stop, previous_stop, previous_stop_id, next_stop_distance and previous_stop_distance.
functions.returns: a table of the values above

functions.name: clock
functions.doc: The game's time of day.

functions.name: speed
functions.doc: The bus's speed in km/h (0 on foot).

functions.name: distance
functions.doc: Metres from the bus to a map point.

functions.name: vars
functions.doc: The names of every variable of the bus's scripts, or with "str" of every string variable.

functions.name: command
functions.doc: Does what a line of the game menu does: refuel, wash, repair, shot, save, load, weather, later, earlier, info, timetable, reset, couple, uncouple.
functions.returns: true when the game knows the command

functions.name: time
functions.doc: Seconds of game time since the plugin started; stands still while the game is paused.

functions.name: after
functions.doc: Runs a function once, later (in game time).

functions.name: every
functions.doc: Runs a function every so many seconds of game time.

functions.name: watch
functions.doc: Runs fn(new, old) whenever a variable changes: kind is "var" (a script variable of the bus), "str" (a string variable) or "sys" (a system variable). In Lua, watch(name, fn) watches a script variable.

functions.name: cancel
functions.doc: Stops a timer or a watch.

functions.name: on
functions.doc: Adds a handler for an event (see the events below, or one of your own sent with emit). As many handlers as you like.

functions.name: off
functions.doc: Removes a handler added with on.

functions.name: emit
functions.doc: Sends an event of your own to the plugin's handlers, with any arguments (handy between the modules of a bigger plugin).

functions.name: message
functions.doc: A line of text on the screen.

functions.name: log
functions.doc: A line in game.log, tagged with the plugin's name. The values are joined with tabs.

functions.name: warn
functions.doc: The same as log, as a warning.

functions.name: save
functions.doc: Writes the plugin's saved data (omsi.data in Lua) at once instead of when the game ends.

functions.name: send
functions.doc: Sends text as one UDP datagram to 127.0.0.1:port: to another program on this computer, never over the network. It does not wait and nothing comes back. Refused: ports below 1024 and the game's multiplayer ports (27015-27024), more than 8 KB, more than 100 messages a second.
functions.returns: true, or false and the reason

functions.name: ui.set
functions.doc: Creates the panel id or replaces it. The panel is a table: anchor, x, y, width, padding, gap, background, radius, accent, visible, clickable and children (text, icon, row, bar, badge, divider, space, button elements). Set it again when its content changes; the same table again changes nothing.
functions.returns: true, or false and the reason ("children[2].size: a number is expected")

functions.name: ui.remove
functions.doc: Removes one of the plugin's panels.

functions.name: ui.clear
functions.doc: Removes every panel of the plugin.

functions.name: ui.toast
functions.doc: A notification card at the top right that slides in and goes after opts.seconds (1 to 60, default 5). opts: title, icon, color, seconds. A plugin shows 8 at most: a ninth makes its oldest go.
functions.returns: true, or false and the reason

functions.name: ui.focus
functions.doc: true gives the plugin's panels the mouse (clicks become ui_click events), false gives it back to the bus. Esc or a game menu gives it back as well.

functions.name: ui.focused
functions.doc: Whether the panels have the mouse.

functions.name: ui.screen
functions.doc: The screen in the panels' pixels and how many of the screen's own pixels one of them is.

events.name: start
events.doc: Right after the plugin was loaded (also after a reload).

events.name: vehicle
events.doc: The player got into a vehicle, changed it, or left it (name nil).

events.name: frame
events.doc: Every frame of the game, after the bus's own scripts; not while paused. Keep it short.

events.name: stop
events.doc: The game ends, or the plugin is about to be loaded again.

events.name: key
events.doc: A key went down (true) or came up (false): "KeyH", "F5", "Numpad8", ...

events.name: next_stop
events.doc: The duty's next stop changed, also to one of the same name (info().next_stop_number tells them apart).

events.name: duty
events.doc: A line and tour were taken, or given up (nil).

events.name: crash
events.doc: The player's bus crashed; above 50 kJ it is a heavy one.

events.name: stops_skipped
events.doc: The duty jumped ahead: the bus passed stops of its trip without stopping (or was moved); stops are numbered in the trip from 1.

events.name: service
events.doc: The bus was serviced or moved. kind: refuel (litres), wash (dirt left, 0 to 1), repair (game minutes), reset or teleport; by: player, plugin, host or game.

events.name: trip_done
events.doc: A trip of the duty ended: how is arrived, skipped or given_up; then the trip's driving, comfort and ticket selling ratings in per cent.

events.name: jolt
events.doc: The bus braked, sped up or cornered hard enough to cost driving rating (m/s², signed); at most one a second.

events.name: ticket_sold
events.doc: A ticket was sold at the cash desk.

events.name: ui_click
events.doc: A button or another clickable part of one of the plugin's panels was clicked (element nil: the panel itself).

events.name: ui_focus
events.doc: The panels got the mouse (true) or gave it back (false).
